newsitem.title: USA: Superior sees $40 mln annually from contract.
newsitem.headline: Superior sees $40 mln annually from contract.

text.p: Superior Industries International Inc said Tuesday its joint venture in Hungary, called SUOFTEC, has won a multi-year contract which along with a previous deal should generate $40 million in annual sales.

SUOFTEC, including Germany-based Otto Fuchs Metallwerke, will supply cast aluminum wheels for Volkswagen AG unit Audi's TT convertible automobile. Shipment of wheels to Audi's plant in Gyor, Hungary, is scheduled to begin in April 1998.
"This additional new business with Audi exemplifies the success of our strategic entry into the European market," Louis Borick, Superior chairman said in a statement.
"Currently, negotiations are under way for increased cast and forged wheel business with other major European OEMs," Borick added.
The contract follows a previously announced order of 700,000 lightweight forged aluminum wheels a year and helps boost annual revenues to the $40 million level.
Moreover, the contract represents the first casting order for the venture's new Hungarian plant.
